page0.text:
...I guess that's how it'll be no matter how much I try to smooth this over.
Tohsaka will challenge me even if I refuse to fight.
When that happens... It'll just be more painful for Tohsaka if I get killed without putting up a fight...

page1.text:
"...Yeah. Once we defeat the Master hiding at school, I'll go back to being enemies with Tohsaka. That's fine, right, Saber?"
"Yes. I have nothing else to say if you understand that. Let us cooperate with Rin and have you build up battle experience."
Saber bows and dismisses herself.
